Faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
Faq.a0: MenuList turns your menu into your entire online presence. Upload a menu photo, PDF, or link — and instantly get a digital menu, QR menu, official business page, and shareable link. Update once, and every surface stays correct automatically.
Faq.q1: Do I need to be technical to use it?
Faq.a1: Not at all. MenuList is built for business owners, not developers. You add your items, set your prices, and publish. The system handles QR codes, formatting, and distribution automatically. Most businesses go live in minutes.
Faq.q2: What happens when I update a price or item?
Faq.a2: You update once in MenuList — and every surface updates instantly. QR codes, digital displays, your public menu page. No reprinting, no re-uploading, no telling staff to use a different version.
Faq.q3: Can I use my own branding and colours?
Faq.a3: Yes. Your menu inherits your business colours, font preferences, and logo. The public-facing menu looks like yours — not like a generic template.
Faq.q4: What types of businesses use MenuList?
Faq.a4: MenuList works for any business that has a menu, price list, or catalogue — restaurants, cafes, salons, spas, retail boutiques, law firms, tutors, and more. If you have items with prices, MenuList can manage and publish them.
Faq.a5: Yes. MenuList runs on Google Cloud / Firebase infrastructure with TLS encryption on all connections. Your data is isolated at the database level — no other business can access it. We use Google OAuth so there are no passwords to breach. See our Trust & Security page for full details.
Faq.a6: Yes. The multi-location plan lets you manage separate menus for each location from a single account — with shared branding and independent pricing. Ideal for chains, franchises, and growing businesses.
Faq.a7: MenuList offers a free plan to get started, with paid plans for businesses that need more surfaces, more locations, or advanced features. Visit the Pricing page for current plans and pricing.
